description: Kick off an end-to-end website build for a real business. Warpweb researches the business (Google Places: hours, address, phone, photos, reviews, service area, category), writes copy in a voice matched to the vertical, picks photos, generates a vertical-aware design, builds a multi-page site (home / about / services / contact + vertical-specific sections), adds SEO (meta tags, sitemap, Schema.org JSON-LD), and deploys to a free `*.warpweb.app` subdomain.  ASYNC: this call returns a `siteId` and `status: "generating"` IMMEDIATELY. Real builds take 3–8 minutes. After calling this, EITHER poll `get_site` every 2–5 seconds until `status` is `complete` or `failed`, OR subscribe to the `site.complete` / `site.failed` lifecycle webhooks on warpweb.ai/app for push delivery (preferred).  Best for service-based local businesses (trades, clinics, salons, agencies, restaurants, real estate) that have a Google Places listing — that's what Warpweb is calibrated for. SaaS or fully-remote companies still work, but the result reads more generic.  Cost: ~200–500 credits, billed at end-of-build against actual AI usage. Failed builds are free.

businessDescription.description: Free-text description of what the business does. Helps when Google Places coverage is thin.

businessLocation.description: City + state/region (e.g. 'Austin, TX'). Strongly recommended — drives local SEO, areas-served copy, and example testimonials.

businessName.description: The business as customers know it (e.g. "Acme Plumbing"). 1–200 chars.

contactEmail.description: Email address. Receives form submissions if no webhook is configured, plus a deploy notice.

designStyle.description: Override the auto-selected design style. Available styles surface in the dashboard.

facebookUrl.description: Public Facebook page URL — used as a research signal.

logoUrl.description: URL to a business logo. Used for branding and color extraction.

ownerPrompt.description: Voice/tone direction or anything to emphasize (e.g. "Emphasize 24/7 emergency service").

uploadedPhotos.description: Array of photo URLs to include on the site.
